rationale: Motor vehicle collision involving damage to the policyholder's own vehicle and bodily injury from the impact.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan's vehicle was rear-ended on Route 9 at a red light yesterday at 8:15 AM by a vehicle traveling ~35 mph with no braking, resulting in a totaled car (trunk crushed into back seat) and the policyholder sustaining whiplash and a sprained wrist. Police report filed with other driver's insurance information available.

case_facts.description: Rear-ended by another vehicle traveling ~35 mph with no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: Totaled; trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.at_fault_party: Other driver (rear-ended claimant at red light)
case_facts.police_report: Filed; other driver's insurance info on report
